talk_pulse.note: multiply base by this per talk column 12-15

halo.note: lerp the core light toward violet by mix[0]..mix[1] in step with the intensity pulse (peak = most violet); talk col 14 / happy / surprised = mix[1]

second_light.note: only where the 2-3 light cap allows (cutscenes, Wisp Night): a wide faint violet halo light

prism_shift.note: Wisp Night / Prism Vault only: lerp the light colour 25% toward each in turn
